data.name: Narayan
data.gender_notes: Narayan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit nara, 'man', + ayana, 'resting place, refuge' — 'the refuge of man'. Its root is Sanskrit nara + ayana. A name of Vishnu. Narayan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Refuge of man; Vishnu”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Narayan expresses “Refuge of man; Vishnu”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit nara, 'man', + ayana, 'resting place, refuge' — 'the refuge of man'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narayan total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
